FAIL_TO_PASS: follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
property-keys-not-renamed: does not rename property keys
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
delete: `delete` operator at the top level is preserved
return-expressions: Track side-effects of method return values
preserves-jsx-member-expression: preserves JSX member expressions
namespace-import-deoptimization: includes namespace import properties accessed in try-catch callbacks
respect-default-export-reexporter-side-effects: respect side-effects in reexporting modules even if moduleSideEffects are off
safest: handles treeshake preset "safest"
side-effects-static-methods: allow calls to pure static methods to be tree-shaken
deep-properties-access: handles deeply nested property accesses
deoptimize-request-treeshaking-pass: makes sure to request additional passes when a variable is deoptimized
object-expression-shadowed-properties: do not remove calls to object expression methods that may have side-effects when properties may be shadowed
json: pipe JSON over stdin to create a module
update-expression-accessors: deoptimizes "this" for accessors triggered by update expressions
handle-object-rest-spread-patterns: handles properties created by an object rest spread operator
non-js-extensions: non .js extensions are preserved
supports-es6-shim: supports es6-shim
transpiles-automatic-with-defaults: transpiles JSX for react
